skills.name: batch
skills.description: Break a large, parallelizable goal into bounded work units, coordinate existing agent/worktree machinery, integrate, and verify. Explicit-only.

skills.name: best-of-n
skills.description: Generate a small set of independent candidate solutions in worktrees, judge them against one explicit rubric, and apply the winner only after PASS verification.

skills.name: dataviz
skills.description: Choose and produce an appropriate chart/dashboard/visual explanation from data, with legible encodings and source/assumption notes.

skills.name: debug
skills.description: Reproduce, minimize, localize, identify root cause, and distinguish diagnosis from an authorized fix. Prefer root-cause over symptom patches.

skills.name: delegate
skills.description: Strategic delegation for multi-step coding, research, or verification work. Use when a task can be split into parent reasoning plus focused sub-agent execution through the agent tool.

skills.name: dependency-update
skills.description: Read release notes/changelogs, update a defined dependency scope, handle breaking changes, and verify. Explicit-only; no broad update-everything by inference.

skills.name: document
skills.description: Write or update repository/product documentation: README, user guides, API docs, architecture, migration notes, and changelog material. This is not the Word-document artifact skill.

skills.name: documents
skills.description: Compatibility alias for the docx skill. Prefer loading docx.

skills.name: docx
skills.description: Create/edit/inspect Word documents using available managed or host capabilities.

skills.name: fleet-manager
skills.description: Use when managing, triaging, restarting, escalating, or summarizing Codewhale fleet runs and workers.

skills.name: flights
skills.description: Track flights and look up status and schedules. Use when: flight status, track a flight, flightaware, arrivals, departures, delays, or a flight number.

skills.name: forget
skills.description: Help the user remove a stored fact using Codewhale's Context Lens when they ask to forget or delete a memory.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.description: Produce intentional, responsive, accessible UI work and perform visual QA instead of generic component assembly.

skills.name: github
skills.description: GitHub via gh — issues, PRs, reviews, search, and CI runs. Use when: user mentions a repo, issue, PR, review, release, workflow run, or anything on github.com.

skills.name: gmail
skills.description: Search, read, draft, and send Gmail when the user asks to work with their inbox or email.

skills.name: goals
skills.description: Set, review, and update the user's goals. Use when: goals, resolutions, track progress, what am I working toward, or holding me accountable.

skills.name: google-calendar
skills.description: Read schedules, check availability, and create or update Google Calendar events when the user asks to work with their calendar.

skills.name: handoff
skills.description: Write a compact, decision-ready handoff so the next session (or the user) can continue without reconstructing the current one. Use when the session is ending, context is running low, the user asks for a handoff / 'pass the baton' / 'hand off', or a long-running operation needs a durable state checkpoint.

skills.name: help
skills.description: Route a "how do I use Codewhale" question to the installed help, config, and doctor surfaces instead of reciting a manual from memory. Explicit-only.

skills.name: image-search
skills.description: Find images on the web and save them locally. Use when: find an image, image search, stock photo, picture of, download an image, or need a visual.

skills.name: implement
skills.description: Carry an authorized, defined request or approved plan through scoped edits and proportionate verification. Skill loading is not write authorization by itself.

skills.name: interview
skills.description: Ask one useful structured question at a time only when material product/implementation choices are genuinely missing; remember answers and produce a brief/spec. Discoverable facts should be investigated instead of asked.

skills.name: local-note
skills.description: A harmless local fixture skill for P17.

skills.name: mcp-builder
skills.description: Design, build, configure, or debug Model Context Protocol servers for codewhale, including stdio and HTTP/SSE transports.

skills.name: mcp-discovery
skills.description: Find and start a zero-environment local MCP server when the session lacks a capability that no available tool, project script, or ordinary local code can cover.

skills.name: money
skills.description: Bank accounts, balances, and transactions via Plaid. Use when: bank, balance, transactions, spending, accounts, or plaid.

skills.name: pdf
skills.description: Read, extract, split, merge, rotate, watermark, fill, OCR, or create PDF files with verification of page counts and text extraction.

skills.name: photos
skills.description: Search a local macOS Photos library and export selected copies when the user asks to find or use their own photos.

skills.name: plan
skills.description: Turn a sufficiently understood task into an ordered implementation plan with dependencies and verification. Orchestrate Codewhale’s native plan state; do not build a parallel planner.

skills.name: plugin-creator
skills.description: Scaffold a local Codewhale plugin bundle with a versioned manifest, namespaced Skills, and an explicit trust review.

skills.name: podcast
skills.description: Turn research into a spoken podcast — script, synthesize, stitch. Use when: podcast, generate a podcast, audio briefing, narrate, or turn this into audio.

skills.name: pptx
skills.description: Create/edit/inspect/verify slide decks and PPTX presentations.

skills.name: presentations
skills.description: Compatibility alias for the pptx skill. Prefer loading pptx.

skills.name: release
skills.description: Prepare a named version: preflight, version consistency, build/package, smoke test, checksums/notes, and release readiness. Publishing/tagging/deploy need separate authorization. Explicit-only.

skills.name: research
skills.description: Current external research using available web tools, primary sources where possible, links/citations, date awareness, synthesis, and unresolved uncertainty.

skills.name: review
skills.description: Diff-scoped correctness review that reads the codebase around the change — callers, contracts, and invariants — and returns line-anchored findings ranked by severity with confidence, then a merge-risk verdict. Use for reviewing a PR, diff, or named change set. Not for style review, approvals-as-rubber-stamp, or editing the code.

skills.name: security-review
skills.description: Review a change, module, or surface for exploitable defects — trust boundaries, authn/authz, injection, secret exposure, filesystem and network reach, dependency risk. Use when the user asks for a security review, audit, or vulnerability check of concrete code. Not for general code review, lint, or compliance paperwork.

skills.name: shopping
skills.description: Product research — compare options, prices, and reviews. Use when: buy, shopping, product recommendation, compare prices, best X to buy, or is this a good deal.

skills.name: simplify
skills.description: Improve clarity and reduce needless complexity after behavior is understood; preserve behavior and keep cleanup separate from correctness fixes.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Create or improve codewhale skills. Use when the user wants a new skill, wants to update an existing skill, or needs guidance on when a skill should be a skill versus MCP, hooks, tools, or a plugin scaffold.

skills.name: skill-installer
skills.description: Install, update, trust, or inspect Codewhale skills from GitHub or local skill folders. Use when the user asks for available skills or wants a community skill installed.

skills.name: spotify
skills.description: Control Spotify playback and search the library and playlists. Use when: spotify, music, playlist, play, pause, or what's playing.

skills.name: spreadsheets
skills.description: Compatibility alias for the xlsx skill. Prefer loading xlsx.

skills.name: test
skills.description: Detect the project’s test stack, run the narrowest useful tests, create tests when authorized, and report coverage/gaps honestly.

skills.name: tts
skills.description: Speak or render text to speech locally. Use when: read aloud, speak, voice output, tts, text to speech, or an audio version of text.

skills.name: verify
skills.description: Exercise the real app/API/CLI and collect observable evidence; tests alone do not count as end-to-end verification.

skills.name: webapp-testing
skills.description: Start/reuse a local app, wait for readiness, inspect rendered state/console/network, act from observed selectors, and verify with evidence.

skills.name: xlsx
skills.description: Create/edit/analyze/verify spreadsheet workbooks including XLSX/CSV/TSV.

scopes.label: Project
scopes.detail: Applies to this workspace only. The engine loads project instructions, hooks and servers only after its own review or trust step; Mona does not approve them for you.

scopes.label: Bundled
scopes.detail: Ships with the pinned engine or a reviewed plugin snapshot. Mona reports the engine’s state and never edits the reviewed bytes.
